mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 42 degrees under overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, with a new moon phase visible overhead.

The City of Verona is currently focused on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which includes updates to water mains, sanitary sewers, and new sidewalks between Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue.
There is plenty to do in town with Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee all happening today.
A notable incident occurred on October 19, when officers conducted a traffic stop on a 49-year-old man and took him into custody due to an active arrest warrant.
Stop by for today's delicious flavor, Chocolate Caramel Twist, and keep in mind that the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
